name: SaunaLife CL7G 6-Person Outdoor Cube Cabin Sauna with Full Glass Front & LED Lighting
description: SaunaLife CL7G Outdoor Cube Cabin Sauna – Spacious Scandinavian Luxury for Six Transform your backyard into a luxurious wellness retreat with the SaunaLife CL7G 6-Person Outdoor Cube Cabin Sauna. Designed with a sleek Scandinavian aesthetic, this sauna features an expansive full-glass front, creating a bright, open atmosphere with stunning outdoor views. The spacious interior boasts contoured thermo-aspen seating and supportive arched backrests, providing unmatched comfort during extended sessions. Built for durability and style, the Thermo-Spruce exterior and shingled roof ensure lasting performance in any outdoor setting. With LED lighting and Wi-Fi connectivity, the CL7G blends modern convenience with timeless relaxation. Experience the ultimate in relaxation and wellness with the SaunaLife CL7G – a perfect harmony of comfort, design, and modern convenience. Key Features: Spacious 6-Person Capacity: Perfect for group relaxation, family gatherings, or solo indulgence. Premium Thermo-Spruce Exterior: Durable, weather-resistant wood with a refined finish. Full Glass Front Wall: Tempered bronze glass for an open, airy atmosphere and scenic views. Ergonomic Seating & Backrests: Contoured thermo-aspen surfaces ensure comfort and cool-to-the-touch relaxation. Wi-Fi Enabled LED Lighting: Adjustable white LED light bar with app-based operation and wireless remote for ambiance control. Durable Shingled Roof: Extra protection against the elements while maintaining a sleek design. Exterior Dimensions (W x D x H): 94.5” x 81.5” x 86.6” Interior Height: Over 7 feet for spacious movement and comfort. Craftsmanship: Handcrafted in Northern Europe by SaunaLife for unmatched quality. Lighting System: Heat and water-rated 24V DC LED with a 30’ light cable for versatile installation.
